description: Search georeferenced wildlife sightings by area, date, taxon, quality grade, annotation, conservation status, observer, project, and licence. Returns a projected record per sighting with coordinates, licence, first photo, and identification counts. An area is given in exactly one form — place_id, the lat/lng/radius triple in kilometres, or a four-corner bounding box — and defaults to research-grade, wild-only records, which are echoed back on every call. Identifications and comments are deliberately not expandable here (one thread is 28 KB); fetch them for specific records with inaturalist_get_observation. page walks the first 10,000 results under any ordering; past 10,000, order by id descending (order_by "id", order "desc") and pass each page’s next_cursor as cursor.

captive.description: True returns captive and cultivated records only — zoo animals, garden plantings; false returns wild records only. Defaults to false.

csi.description: IUCN-normalised conservation status codes to include, e.g. ["EN","CR"]. Decode them with inaturalist_list_reference topic conservation_status_codes.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous id-descending page, to continue past the 10,000-result window — a positive integer observation id, sent upstream as id_below. Mutually exclusive with page, and forces order_by "id", order "desc".

d1.description: Earliest observation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive. Must be on or before d2.

endemic.description: Restrict to taxa endemic to the observation location.

hrank.description: Highest (coarsest) taxonomic rank of the identification to accept. Must be at or above lrank; ranks compare by rank level.

iconic_taxa.description: Broad organism groups, by their scientific iconic-taxon name. A common-name value such as "Birds" matches nothing upstream, so only the listed values are accepted.

include.description: Embedded arrays to expand per record. Check photo_count and sound_count first — expanding costs context.

introduced.description: Restrict to taxa introduced to the observation location.

lat.description: Latitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lng and radius.

license.description: Restrict to records whose own license_code is one of these, e.g. ["cc-by","cc0"] for reuse with attribution only. Decode the codes with inaturalist_list_reference topic licenses; all-rights-reserved records have no code to pass.

licensed.description: Restrict to records whose own license_code is not null — any licence, NonCommercial and NoDerivatives variants included. For specific licences, use license.

lng.description: Longitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lat and radius.

lrank.description: Lowest (finest) taxonomic rank of the identification to accept. Equal to hrank for an exact-rank match.

native.description: Restrict to taxa native to the observation location.

nelat.description: North-east corner latitude of the bounding box, at or north of swlat. All four corners or none.

nelng.description: North-east corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none. West of swlng is accepted: it describes a box crossing the antimeridian.

order_by.description: Sort field. Set "id" with order "desc" to walk past 10,000 results: that is the one ordering next_cursor continues, so it is the only one that issues a next_cursor. A cursor forces it.

page.description: Page number within the first 10,000 results, under any ordering. Defaults to 1. Mutually exclusive with cursor.

per_page.description: Records fetched per page. Complete records may be deferred to keep the response within its byte budget; retrieve deferred ids through inaturalist_get_observation with the same include values. Ceiling: 25; oversized values are clamped.

photo_license.description: Restrict to records carrying at least one photo under one of these licence codes. Matched independently of the record’s own license_code, so check each photo’s license_code before reusing it.

photo_licensed.description: Restrict to records with at least one licensed photo, under any licence. For specific licences, use photo_license.

place_id.description: Numeric iNaturalist place id from inaturalist_find_places. Mutually exclusive with the lat/lng/radius triple and the bounding box. A non-numeric value answers HTTP 500 upstream.

project_id.description: Restrict to observations in one project, by numeric project id from inaturalist_resolve_name type project.

q.description: Free text matched across observation properties.

quality_grade.description: Identification confidence tiers to include, normalized to unique values in first-appearance order. Defaults to research-grade only; adding "needs_id" roughly doubles the corpus and lowers identification confidence.

radius.description: Search radius around lat/lng, in KILOMETRES, greater than 0. Requires lat and lng. The upstream publishes no bound; 500 is a verified ceiling this server imposes.

search_on.description: Narrow what q matches against. Requires q.

sounds.description: True selects observations with sounds; false selects those without. Omit for either. Use include: ["sounds"] to expand sound metadata; no media is downloaded.

swlat.description: South-west corner latitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

swlng.description: South-west corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

taxon_id.description: Restrict to this taxon and its descendants. Resolve a name to an id with inaturalist_resolve_name.

term_id.description: Annotation attribute ids, from inaturalist_list_reference topic controlled_terms — e.g. 1 for Life Stage.

term_value_id.description: Annotation value ids, from the same attribute listing — e.g. 6 for Larva. Requires term_id; sent alone it is ignored upstream and the unfiltered corpus comes back.

threatened.description: Restrict to taxa considered threatened where observed.

user_id.description: Restrict to one observer, by numeric user id from inaturalist_resolve_name type user. Mutually exclusive with user_login.

user_login.description: Restrict to one observer, by login — the login on an inaturalist_resolve_name user candidate, a leaderboard entry, or an observation’s observer. Mutually exclusive with user_id.

name: inaturalist_search_observations

applied_filters.description: The server-applied defaults and overrides that determine what this answer means.

captive.description: Captive-only when true, wild-only when false.

ordering_forced_by_cursor.description: True when a cursor overrode the requested ordering.

quality_grade.description: Identification tiers actually searched, normalized to unique values in first-appearance order.

deferred.description: Ordered ids of the fetched-page suffix omitted from observations to meet the response budget. Empty when the whole page fits; independent of has_more.

items.description: One fetched observation deferred for a by-id call.

observation_id.description: Observation id to retrieve through inaturalist_get_observation with the same include values.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_place_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because place_id does not exist. `invalid_geography`: An area was given partially, in two forms at once, with a radius of 0 or less, or with nelat south of swlat. `inverted_date_range`: d1 is after d2. `inverted_rank_range`: hrank is a finer rank than lrank. `result_window_exceeded`: page multiplied by per_page would reach past the upstream 10,000-result window. `conflicting_pagination`: Both page and cursor were supplied. `unpaired_annotation_value`: term_value_id was supplied without term_id. `search_on_without_query`: search_on was supplied without q. `conflicting_observer`: user_id and user_login were both supplied. `unknown_taxon_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the taxon_id does not exist. `unknown_user`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the user_id or user_login names no observer. `unknown_project_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the project_id does not exist. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when the fetched page filled the applied per_page and more records follow, independent of deferred ids. On the page path an exactly full final page is false; under a cursor, where the offset is unknown, every full page is true.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor to continue past this page. Present only when has_more is true and the page was ordered by id descending; under any other ordering, raise page instead.

notice.description: Composed guidance for applied limits, ignored filters, empty pages, deferred ids and pagination.

items.description: One complete projected search record, with requested media expansions.

agreements.description: How many identifications currently agree with the community taxon.

annotations.description: Decoded annotations. Present when "annotations" was included.

items.description: One decoded annotation on the record.

attribute.description: Attribute label, e.g. "Life Stage"; null for an unknown id.

attribute_id.description: Attribute id, usable as term_id on the search tools.

by.description: Login of the member who added the annotation.

value.description: Value label, e.g. "Larva"; null for an unknown id.

value_id.description: Value id, usable as term_value_id on the search tools.

captive.description: True for a zoo animal, a garden planting, or other cultivation.

community_taxon_id.description: Consensus taxon id. Differs from taxon.id while a thread is contested.

accuracy_m.description: Public accuracy radius, metres. An obscured point is a locality, not a sighting position.

coordinate.description: Public coordinate. Null when the record carries none.

disagreements.description: How many identifications currently disagree with the community taxon.

geoprivacy.description: Observer-set coordinate privacy: obscured, obscured_private, open, or private.

id.description: Observation id. Also the cursor value for deep pagination.

identifications_count.description: Tally against the community taxon: agreements + disagreements. Excludes the observer and neutral/withdrawn ids; thread size is identifications_total on inaturalist_get_observation.

license_code.description: Licence of the observation record itself. Null means all rights reserved.

obscured.description: True when the true coordinate is withheld; the public point is a locality.

observed_on.description: Observation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Null when the observer recorded no date.

anyOf.description: A photo with the attribution and licence that must travel with it.

attribution.description: Verbatim attribution; reproduce with any use of the image.

license_code.description: Photo licence code. Null means all rights reserved, independent of the record.

medium_url.description: Medium image URL; derived from the size path if needed. Absent when no variant is available.

open.description: True when served from the open-licence host at fetch time; licences can change.

square_url.description: 75px square variant, exactly as upstream published it. Null when absent.

photo.description: First photo on the record. Null when there are none.

photo_count.description: Photo count; include "photos" for every photo.

photos.description: Every photo on the record. Present when "photos" was included.

items.description: A photo with the attribution and licence that must travel with it.

attribution.description: Verbatim attribution; reproduce with any use of the image.

license_code.description: Photo licence code. Null means all rights reserved, independent of the record.

medium_url.description: Medium image URL; derived from the size path if needed. Absent when no variant is available.

open.description: True when served from the open-licence host at fetch time; licences can change.

square_url.description: 75px square variant, exactly as upstream published it. Null when absent.

place_guess.description: Locality text written by the observer. Third-party free text.

quality_grade.description: Identification confidence tier: research, needs_id, or casual.

sound_count.description: How many audio recordings the record carries.

sounds.description: Audio recordings. Present when "sounds" was included.

items.description: An audio recording with its attribution and licence.

license_code.description: Sound licence code. Null means all rights reserved.

url.description: Audio file URL. Null when upstream published none.

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

iconic_taxon_name.description: Broad organism group, e.g. "Insecta". Usable as an iconic_taxa filter value.

id.description: Taxon id — the identifier every taxon-scoped filter takes.

taxon.description: Current identification. Null when nobody has identified the record.

taxon_geoprivacy.description: Coordinate privacy applied automatically for a threatened taxon. Same vocabulary.

url.description: Canonical iNaturalist page for the record.

uuid.description: Stable UUID, independent of the id sequence.

shown.description: How many records this page carries.

total_results.description: How many records upstream reports as matching. An estimate over a live index — it drifts between calls seconds apart.

truncated.description: True when records were deferred or more pages follow.

title: Inaturalist Search Observations
